title: Jump: the dino leaves the ground on intent.jump, rises under gravity, falls back and lands; no second jump while airborne
body:
## Context

`docs/TICKETS.md` lists t1 as the first ticket and `DECISIONS.md` (D5) says jumping is deliberately absent from the skeleton: `step()` in `src/game.js` advances `tick` and `distance` and ignores the intent, and `dino.vy` / `dino.onGround` exist in the state but nothing writes them. The page (`index.html`) already turns Space / ArrowUp / a tap into `intent.jump` (edge-triggered: once per press, on the next tick) and the renderer already draws the dino at `dino.y`, so the whole ticket is one rule in `src/game.js` plus two numbers in `src/tuning.js`.

## Scope

1. `src/tuning.js` (additive keys under `TUNING`): `gravity` (px per tick², positive = down) and `jumpVelocity` (px per tick, the upward impulse; store it as a positive number and apply it as a negative `vy`). Pick values that keep a jump in the air for roughly 30–40 ticks at 60 Hz; the exact numbers are yours.
2. `src/game.js`: on a tick where `intent.jump` is true AND `dino.onGround` is true, set `dino.vy = -jumpVelocity` and `dino.onGround = false`. On every tick the dino is airborne: `dino.vy += gravity`, then `dino.y += dino.vy`; when `dino.y + dino.h >= TUNING.groundY`, clamp `dino.y = TUNING.groundY - dino.h`, set `dino.vy = 0` and `dino.onGround = true`. `intent.jump` while airborne does nothing. A run that is `over` keeps ignoring every intent (existing behaviour).
3. Tests (`tests/jump.test.mjs`, or additions to `tests/game.test.mjs`): the acceptance criteria below, as assertions. Every existing test stays green; the replay test stays green (no randomness is involved in this ticket).
4. Docs, in the same commit as the rule: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` documents `dino.vy` / `dino.onGround` and the two tuning numbers; `docs/TICKETS.md` moves t1 to Done; `DECISIONS.md` D5 stops listing jumping as absent.

## Acceptance criteria

- A1. `createGame()` then `step(state, { jump: true, duck: false, restart: false })` leaves `dino.onGround === false` and `dino.y < TUNING.groundY - dino.h` (the dino left the ground on that tick).
- A2. Stepping on with `NO_INTENT`, `dino.y` first decreases (rises) and then increases (falls) — there is a tick where `dino.vy` changes sign — and within 200 ticks `dino.onGround === true`, `dino.y === TUNING.groundY - dino.h` exactly and `dino.vy === 0`.
- A3. While airborne, a second `{ jump: true }` changes nothing: `dino.vy` after that tick equals what one gravity step would have produced with `NO_INTENT`.
- A4. The dino never sinks below the ground: over a 600-tick run with `jump: true` on every tick, `dino.y + dino.h <= TUNING.groundY` holds on every tick.
- A5. No spontaneous jump: 100 ticks of `NO_INTENT` on a fresh run leave `dino.onGround === true` and `dino.y` unchanged.
- A6. `npm run play -- --ticks 300 --every 60` still runs and prints its JSON summary (with no obstacles yet the policy never asks for a jump, so the frames keep showing `D` on the ground).
- A7. The gates are green on the integrated tree: `npm test && npm run lint && npm run build`.

## Out of scope

Ducking, obstacles, collision, score, variable jump height (holding the key), double jump, sprites, sound. Those are t2 and t3 or nothing at all.

## References

`docs/TICKETS.md` (t1 and "The rules"), `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (State, Intent), `DECISIONS.md` (D1–D5), `src/game.js`, `src/tuning.js`, `src/render.js`, `index.html`, `tests/game.test.mjs`, `scripts/play.mjs`.
